results.title: Love in the Countryside
results.overview: Ana, a city girl, raised in comfort, has managed to upset her father. In order to learn some humility and appreciate life in its simplicity, Ana is "exiled" to the countryside, to live with her grandmother for a while. For Ana, life in the village is a nightmare: heels sink into the mud, internet not so much, and people are strange.

results.title: The Summoning of Chloe Kane
results.overview: The wealthy Kane family moves from Philadelphia to a 700-year-old castle in Germany, where Chloe's disturbing psychic visions reveal a dark past, and she must use her abilities to save her loved ones from the malevolent forces within.

results.title: The Bargain
results.overview: A young girl summons the Devil to get justice from her abusive foster father. The Devil is willing to make a deal but in Ruth’s desire for revenge exceeds her nerve. A chilling tale of revenge, religion and desperation in our lowest moments.

results.title: 119 Emergency Call 2026 YOKOHAMA BLACKOUT
results.original_title: 119エマージェンシーコール2026 YOKOHAMA BLACKOUT
results.overview: New Year SP set one year after the series: at Yokohama City Fire Dept.’s command center on New Year’s holiday, an AI dispatcher plan sparks debate, then a massive blackout hits, swamping operators with life-or-death calls.

results.title: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
results.original_title: Mojo Brookzz: I Know You Lying
results.overview: Scene-stealer Mojo Brookzz unloads on freaky partners, wild BBL culture and his niece's big coming-out present in his debut Netflix special.

results.title: O'Slaughter Day
results.overview: The day before Christmas, the Veterinary Board receives a positive A test result from a wild boar shot by a hunter. The young veterinary officer has a disposal machine ready and starts touring the farms in his former home village. The very first farm in Kiuma village is home to the elderly and childless Ants and Minna. For the couple, their domestic animals are a substitute for their missing children and loved ones. At the same time, Ants' nephews arrive with their wives and children. The goal is to quickly deliver the gifts and drive back home to the city. But the farmer Ants announces the situation he is in with his animals, and now he needs the help of his relatives to slaughter the pigs.

results.title: Bad Girl Office
results.overview: Alisa has a shoplifting problem. Out of options, she is sent to the office of unorthodox educator and coach, John Mahler. With his confrontational approach, Mahler tries to get to the heart of the matter, but is met with resistance. Alisa confesses to him that she doesn't want to attend these sessions, and that she wants to be left alone. Sensing that she has a good heart, John doesn't give up. Instead, he tries a variety of methods, determined to reform this bad girl from her wicked ways. Bad Girl Office is a feature that explores how two very different people can come together, how help and change is possible in a human being, and how a person can heal from the pain in their past.

results.title: The Secrets of the Matriarch
results.overview: Danielle travels to New Orleans to meet her grandmother and uncover the truth about her mother's death. Drawn into a dangerous feud with the rival Benoit family, Danielle learns her mother’s death was no accident and must navigate treachery, uncover secrets, and decide whether to destroy both families' legacies to find justice.

results.title: Siri Hustvedt – Dance Around the Self
results.original_title: Siri Hustvedt – Dance Around the Self
results.overview: Sabine Lidl presents Siri Hustvedt’s journey from her first novel to being a leading voice in contemporary literature – a film about feminist perspectives, Hustvedt’s soulmate Paul Auster, and the power of thought.

results.title: Cidro Asmoro
results.overview: When a musician's composition achieves unexpected digital virality through a café waitress's unauthorized cover, a commercial strategist orchestrates a collaborative duet between the two artists, igniting an interpersonal conflict driven by their sharply contrasting professional objectives.

results.title: Wolfsbane
results.overview: Combe Noire forest, French Alps. The daughter of a troubled man comes to gather his things, 6 months after her father went missing. She soon realizes that something unnatural is happening in Combe Noire, and that Mother Earth might be sending her hounds onto us.

results.title: Portent
results.overview: A woman seeking isolation goes solo car camping but finds alone time scarce.

results.title: Backwood: The Camp Massacre
results.overview: A remote teen camp, a dark legend, and a masked killer who strikes at night. What begins as a summer idyll ends in a nightmare of fear, terror, and pure panic. An uncompromising slasher film  - brutal, thrilling, merciless.

results.title: Unrequited
results.overview: In "Unrequited", Liam finds himself enchanted by Dex, a captivating waiter, sparking a whirlwind of one-sided affection that intertwines fantasy with reality. Struggling to cope with his unrequited love, Liam seeks therapy, embarking on a transformative journey of self-discovery. As he learns to harness the power of his imagination, he gains the courage to redefine his narrative, crafting a new story filled with bold possibilities and unexpected adventures. Will Liam find the love he seeks, or will he learn to write his own happily-ever-after?

results.title: Purebred
results.overview: During a heatwave in Belfast, transgender man Owen returns to the flat of his on-off-again lover Seán after taking a pregnancy test.

A film about the end of the world and the end of a roll of toilet paper. In his deftly playful work shot on 16mm, filmmaker (and musician) Ondřej Vavrečka reminisces, says his farewells and also reflects on the limits of progress. Via three fictional characters, each of whom responds differently to the impulses of their surroundings, he simultaneously enhances the sensitivity of the film audience. Will a pain we experience leave a scar or merely a colourless memory? And will someone remember the old Vysočany station a hundred years from now? In its poetic charm this cinematic piece is almost tactile in nature; it awakens all the senses and, in places, bears the hallmark of Jan Švankmajer, if the latter had been born an essential optimist, that is. Film as a whisper emanating from smiling lips. (Viktor Palák, KVIFF)

results.title: Your House
results.overview: Four homes share a looming threat.

results.title: A Story Carved on a Tree
results.original_title: A Story Carved on a Tree
results.overview: When 13-year-old Nisha insults the powerful village Sarpanch, she’s chased by his vengeful son from bus stop to home. Scared and tired, she starts having nightmares about a ghostly woman. But soon, Nisha learns the ghost is actually her grandmother, who had once stood up to the same injustice.Inspired by her, Nisha finds the strength to stand her ground and reclaim her dignity.
